blueprints.title: Agent-to-agent (A2A)
blueprints.use_when: Handing an outcome to an autonomous agent you do not own — another team's or another company's — by specifying the goal rather than the call

blueprints.title: AG-UI frontend streaming
blueprints.use_when: The interface has to show what the agent is doing while it works: tokens, tool calls, thinking traces, interruptions

blueprints.title: Agent loop
blueprints.use_when: Building the loop that calls a model, runs the tools it asks for and repeats until it stops; or an agent runs away, loops, or will not stop on its own

blueprints.title: Agent protocols overview
blueprints.use_when: Choosing which wire protocol fits — tools, agent-to-agent delegation, frontend streaming — when an agent has to talk to something outside its own process

blueprints.title: Agent trajectory evaluation
blueprints.use_when: Grading the path a multi-step agent took — which tools it chose, in what order, how it recovered from errors and what it cost — not only its final answer

blueprints.title: Agentic RAG
blueprints.use_when: One retrieval pass is not enough: the agent has to search, judge what came back and search again, across several sources or several steps

blueprints.title: Chunking strategies
blueprints.use_when: Deciding how documents are split before indexing; retrieved chunks are truncated, mix several topics, or lose the structure of the source

blueprints.title: Context engineering
blueprints.use_when: Deciding what occupies the model's context on a long run: the agent forgets what was said early on, quality falls off as the run grows, or cost is dominated by re-sending history

blueprints.title: Contextual retrieval
blueprints.use_when: Retrieved chunks are relevant but unusable on their own — pronouns without antecedents, numbers without units, sections without a subject

blueprints.title: Cost and rate limits
blueprints.use_when: Token spend is unpredictable or unattributable, the bill grows faster than usage, or provider 429s are reaching users

blueprints.title: Data quality and PII
blueprints.use_when: Validating what enters the index, and detecting, redacting or gating personal data before it is irreversibly embedded, logged and retrievable

blueprints.title: Document parsing
blueprints.use_when: Inputs are PDFs, Office files, HTML or scans and have to become clean text that keeps headings, tables, reading order and page provenance

blueprints.title: Embedding pipeline
blueprints.use_when: Embedding text at scale: batching, rate limits, caching, retries, and the migration path for the day the embedding model changes

blueprints.title: Eval harness design
blueprints.use_when: Turning 'this seems better' into a number: the dataset, the scorers and the runner, before the second change to any LLM system

blueprints.title: Evaluator and optimizer
blueprints.use_when: First drafts are reliably mediocre and the quality criteria can be stated, so a critic scores each attempt and the generator revises until it clears a bar

blueprints.title: Few-shot examples and reasoning
blueprints.use_when: Output format is inconsistent, or the task needs multi-step derivation, and it is unclear whether to add examples or a reasoning scaffold

blueprints.title: Framework selection
blueprints.use_when: Choosing what an agent runs on — a plain loop, a graph framework, a provider SDK or a managed platform — at the start of a project, or revisiting that choice

blueprints.title: LLM gateway
blueprints.use_when: More than one service or provider is being called, and keys, retries, fallbacks, caching, quotas and cost attribution should sit in one place in front of them

blueprints.title: GraphRAG
blueprints.use_when: Questions are about relationships between entities, or need aggregating across the whole corpus, which independent chunk retrieval structurally cannot answer

blueprints.title: Guardrails and injection defence
blueprints.use_when: The system reads content it did not author — user text, web pages, email, uploaded files, third-party tool results — and a model follows instructions hidden inside it

blueprints.title: Human in the loop
blueprints.use_when: An agent can spend money, message people, delete data or write to production, and some actions need an approval gate, a sandbox or a dry run before they execute

blueprints.title: Hybrid search with RRF
blueprints.use_when: Search misses exact strings — error codes, SKUs, function names, proper nouns — or recall is short with embeddings alone, so lexical and dense results have to be fused

blueprints.title: Incremental sync and CDC
blueprints.use_when: Keeping a derived index current by processing only what changed; a full re-run is too slow or too costly, or the index has drifted from its source

blueprints.title: Ingestion pipeline
blueprints.use_when: Documents or records have to be loaded continuously into an index or store, with idempotency, incremental runs, and one bad document not stopping the batch

blueprints.title: LLM as judge
blueprints.use_when: Quality is genuinely subjective and no deterministic check exists, so a model scores the output; or the judge's scores disagree with human raters

blueprints.title: MCP authorization
blueprints.use_when: A remote or multi-user MCP server has to establish who is calling and what they may do: OAuth 2.1, issuer validation, and scoping that survives prompt injection

blueprints.title: MCP protocol overview
blueprints.use_when: A capability has to be reachable from more than one AI application or owned by another team, and MCP is the candidate; understanding the protocol before building on it

blueprints.title: MCP server design
blueprints.use_when: Building an MCP server someone else will use: what it exposes, which primitive each capability should be, state and errors across a stateless boundary, versioning

blueprints.title: MCP tool design
blueprints.use_when: Designing the tool surface of an MCP server for consumers you will never meet, running models you did not choose, in contexts you cannot see

blueprints.title: MCP transports
blueprints.use_when: Deciding between stdio and Streamable HTTP for shipping a server, or migrating one written before the 2026-07-28 revision

blueprints.title: Memory architecture
blueprints.use_when: The agent has to remember across sessions: facts learned in one run applying to the next, user preferences that persist, or any store of knowledge outside the context window

blueprints.title: Observability and tracing
blueprints.use_when: A production run cannot be reconstructed: no traces of LLM calls and agent steps with inputs, outputs, tokens, cost and outcome, and a user's complaint cannot be reproduced

blueprints.title: Orchestrator and workers
blueprints.use_when: A lead model has to split a task into subtasks at runtime and dispatch them to workers with their own context windows; multi-agent, search-heavy work

blueprints.title: Parallelization
blueprints.use_when: Running model calls concurrently — independent sections merged at the end, or the same task sampled several times and voted on to raise reliability

blueprints.title: Progressive tool discovery
blueprints.use_when: The agent has more than about fifteen tools, tool schemas dominate the prompt, or accuracy drops with every tool added

blueprints.title: Prompt caching
blueprints.use_when: The same prefix goes out on every call and should be billed once; or caching is configured and the hit rate is near zero

blueprints.title: Prompt chaining
blueprints.use_when: The steps are known in advance and always the same, and each one can be checked before the next runs — a fixed pipeline of model calls rather than an agent

blueprints.title: Prompt structure
blueprints.use_when: Writing or reworking a production prompt: what belongs in the system block, in what order, how the sections are delimited, and which parts have to stay byte-stable

blueprints.title: Query transformation
blueprints.use_when: Questions are conversational, vague or multi-part, or worded nothing like the corpus, so the query has to be rewritten, expanded or decomposed before it reaches the index

blueprints.title: RAG baseline
blueprints.use_when: Answers have to come from a document corpus the model was not trained on, the corpus changes, or answers must cite their sources; retrieval is being set up, or the model hallucinates and cannot attribute what it says

blueprints.title: RAG evaluation
blueprints.use_when: Measuring a RAG system so a regression points at retrieval or at generation, instead of tuning chunk size, k and the prompt by feel

blueprints.title: Regression and CI evals
blueprints.use_when: Wiring evals into the development loop so a quality regression blocks a merge instead of reaching users

blueprints.title: Reranking
blueprints.use_when: The right chunk is retrieved but ranked far down: recall is high and precision in the top few is low, or k must be cut before the prompt without losing the answer

blueprints.title: Routing
blueprints.use_when: Inputs fall into distinct families needing different prompts, models or tools, and one prompt for all of them degrades every case; classifying an input before handling it

blueprints.title: Security and secrets
blueprints.use_when: Credential scoping, storage and rotation for a system where a model can call tools, read external content, or serve more than one tenant

blueprints.title: Simulated users
blueprints.use_when: Evaluating a multi-turn or conversational agent, or offline scores look good while production behaviour does not match them

blueprints.title: Skill engineering
blueprints.use_when: Writing the markdown procedures an agent loads on demand — skills, playbooks, the instructions that keep being pasted into chat by hand

blueprints.title: Small models and distillation
blueprints.use_when: One task type dominates the token bill or the latency budget and should move to a smaller model, a fine-tune or a distilled student

blueprints.title: State machine and reducer
blueprints.use_when: State changes have to be deterministic and auditable while the model only decides; the agent loses the thread because its state lives in the conversation

blueprints.title: Structured output
blueprints.use_when: The model's output feeds code and has to parse every time: JSON that keeps failing, schema-constrained decoding, tool-call schemas, validation and repair

blueprints.title: Tool design
blueprints.use_when: An agent has more than one tool and picks the wrong one, sends malformed arguments, or misreads what a tool returned; tool schemas, descriptions and return shapes are being written or reworked

blueprints.title: Vector store selection
blueprints.use_when: Choosing where embeddings live and which index and metadata filtering they use; or the store's recall, p95 latency or cost has become the constraint
